definition.def: A portion of something is a part of it.
examples: Damage was confined to a small portion of the castle. [+ of]
I have spent a fairly considerable portion of my life here. [+ of]
I had learnt a portion of the Koran. [+ of]
Insurance can represent a significant portion of the total price of a holiday.

definition.def: A portion is the amount of food that is given to one person at a meal.
examples: Desserts can be substituted by a portion of fresh fruit.
...fish and chips at about £2.70 a portion.
